anchor_value: source places GBP symbol in Par / Units, not Amortized Cost

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Armstrong Bidco Limited(11)(21) | First lien senior secured loan | SA + | 5.00 % | 6/2029 | GBP symbol | 26,570 | 31,986 | 32,187 | 2.0 %
Armstrong Bidco Limited(11)(21) | First lien senior secured delayed draw term loan | SA + | 5.00 % | 6/2029 | GBP symbol | 13,863 | 16,680 | 16,794 | 1.0 %

findings.detail: The GBP symbol was assigned to cost_currency for the Armstrong Bidco loan rows even though the symbol is in the Par / Units column and the following values are amortized cost.
The delayed draw term loan has the same misplaced GBP symbol in Par / Units, with amortized cost shown separately as 16,680.

rationale: FX03 is a real data error. The flagged holdings store cost_currency=GBP for the two Armstrong Bidco Limited rows, but the raw SOI grid shows the GBP symbol in the Par / Units column immediately before 26,570 and 13,863. The amortized cost values are the separate following values, 31,986 and 16,680, so the GBP unit was carried from par/units onto cost_currency rather than grounded in the cost column.
